name: Cohere
short: Enterprise and developer LLMs featuring the Command model family, embedding, and reranking endpoints with an ongoing free evaluation tier.

plans.name: Trial API Key
plans.notes: Default free tier on signup ($0/mo, no credit card required). Generates a personal Trial API key for your own environment: capped at 1,000 calls/month across all endpoints, 20 RPM on Chat (Command R, Command R+, Command A), strictly for evaluation and prototyping.

plans.name: Production Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Unlocked by adding a payment method. Removes the 1,000 monthly call ceiling, raises rate limits, and licenses usage for commercial production applications.
